Eyes On Government Special Edition: Exclusive Interviews with Sen. Hillary Clinton and Rep. Silvestre Reyes (2008)
interviews.description: An Eyes On Government special edition hosted by Joe Oliva. Joe Oliva interviews Senator Hillary Clinton, campaigning in El Paso ahead of the 2008 Texas primary, and Congressman Silvestre Reyes. The conversations focus mostly on immigration reform, and also cover healthcare and adoption.
